result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles (`mvn -q -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run any tests or try either command, so the dispatch and the `-help` output are unchecked.

- **`Commands.java`**:
  - Added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - Added `analyzeLandscape` to the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**:
  - Both command names now go to the same method.
  - `-help` prints the usage and description of whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is kept for existing scripts.
